data.title: 芙莉莲 · 超市试吃
data.description: 大型超市热闹的熟食试吃区前，芙莉莲神情极其严肃地用牙签扎起一小块煎香肠放入口中，细细咀嚼后认真地点了点头——「味道很浓郁。听说只要假装挑选商品就能免费一直吃……这种被称作‘试吃’的习俗，简直比寻找魔法书还要美妙。」
data.action: 用一根牙签送一小块煎香肠到嘴边，另一只手扶着购物篮
data.lighting: 超市顶灯下的柔白光，试吃台上方的暖灯照亮瓷盘
data.promptProse: At the supermarket tasting counter, Frieren holds a short wooden pick with one cube of browned sausage no larger than a fingertip. She brings it close enough to smell it while holding a green basket at her hip. The cuffs of her blue canvas jacket are folded back. A shallow tray of separate sample pieces stands at the corner of the counter, and the bright grocery aisle recedes behind her.
data.animaCaption: Between her thumb and forefinger is a short toothpick with a single small browned cube at its tip. She raises that bite toward her lips, the shopping basket still in her other hand.
